messages:
Maya: Planning check 10am Wed micro-office-hours + follow-up credit funnel. Small live Q&A (20m) aimed at PMs and engs. Idea: instant 50 credits on signup, +100 bonus if they submit a quick feedback form within 48h.
Omar: Sounds good. Landing should show claimed credits immediately and surface 1 suggested template based on role selection.
Sasha: Role selector: Developer / PM / Growth. Templates: bug-triage (dev), meeting-notes (pm), copy-ads (growth). I'll draft.
Elliot: Measurement: primary KPI = percent of webinar registrants who hit "activated" within 7d. Define "activated" as either (a) used a template AND request tokens>=40 OR (b) made 3+ requests.
Priya: I'll instrument event name 'webinar_activation_v2' with properties: tokens, template_id, request_count, utm_source.
Tom: For the credits: expire 14d. Prevent repeat claims by email + phone fingerprint. Add soft throttling: max 2 claims per ip/day. Security review needed.
Zoe: For email flow: immediate claim confirmation, 24h tutorial + template tips, 48h feedback nudge with bonus unlock. A/B test timing (24h vs 36h) and CTA copy.
Maya: Good. Also add a short benchmark slide: "Starter cohort achieved 18% faster time-to-first-use vs organic with credit nudges" 18% is our target delta. Keep wording conservative.
Omar: I'll own landing + claim API. ETA Mon noon for QA.
Sasha: Draft templates by Mon EOD. Will include quick examples and one-liners for social.
Elliot: Analytics: cohort = utm_campaign:launchloop2025. We'll compare against last 30d baseline. Also track retention at 7d and 14d.
Priya: ops-bot: create routing tag 'launchloop-web' and rule: if company_type=enterprise AND want_sales=true -> sales-ops, else -> self-serve.
ops-bot: Rule created: id=1887, tag=launchloop-web, predicate=(company_type=="enterprise" AND want_sales==true). Details: https://internal.ops/rules/1887
Tom: Security: I'll ping @security and add captcha challenge on claim if unusual activity detected.
Zoe: Social copy (short): "Micro-office-hours: ship LLM features with real prompts + credits. Wed 10am PT. RSVP -> instant credits + bonus for feedback." Thoughts?
Maya: Love it. Keep CTA: RSVP & claim. Use UTM on all links.
Omar: Claim API snippet: ```js
await fetch('/v1/promo/claim', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({code:'LAUNCHLOOP25'})})
```
Sasha: I'll create the template pack zip and upload to drive. Will reference it in the welcome modal.
Elliot: Experiment tag in Amplitude: exp_launchloop_2025. Priya, can you set the A/B buckets there?
Priya: Yep, creating buckets now. Experiment id: exp_2025_launchloop.
Maya: Owners recap: Landing/API=Omar, Templates=Sasha, Emails=Zoe, Credits infra=Tom, Analytics=Elliot, Routing=Priya. Dry run Tue 3pm PT.
Omar: Branch opened and PR up for review.
Tom: Security signoff pending; will aim for Monday morning.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Tue 2:45pm -> #marketing, #eng-oncall
eng-bot: Scheduled build pipeline for landing branch and smoke test at Tue 2:30pm.
Maya: Thanks all. Please drop final copy + assets in /shared/marketing/launchloop by Mon 11am.
